summary: FERC's November 2, 2026 combined notice of filings lists PJM's ER27-330-000 reliability backstop amendments and its ER27-330-001 errata, with a comment date of November 30, 2026 for both.

points.point: The notice lists ER27-330-000, PJM's proposed Reliability Backstop Procurement amendments in ER26-3380, filed October 29, 2026.
points.quote: Proposed Amendments to the Reliability Backstop Procurement in ER26-3380 to be effective 1/15/2027.

points.point: The errata filing ER27-330-001 was filed October 30, 2026 and carries the same November 30 comment date.
points.quote: Errata to Correct Metadata and Waiver Request in RBP Compliance Filing to be effective 1/29/2027.

throughLine.text: Sets the comment date for PJM's ER27-330 backstop amendments, the capacity adequacy filing that runs beside the E-7 show cause proceeding.
